findings.text: follow-on: the done-when's keeps-its-stored-review assertion compares the record's plan_fingerprint against whole, the value the test handed to _store_review at line 96, so the two sides move together and the assertion stays true under a regression that changes which forms are accepted; it proves the store round-trips, not the collapse-stability the done-when names.

follow-on: forms[0] is compared to plan_review.plan_fingerprint(path), the call that produces forms[0] itself, so the assertion is a tautology that can fail only if _fingerprint_forms stops returning plan_fingerprint first.

follow-on: baseline_suite and after_suite carry placeholders (the 42 test files importing reckon/crew/plan_review.py that existed at base, and all 44 test files importing reckon/crew/plan_review.py) in their command fields instead of the literal command the manifest schema requires, so the command is readable only from the arm logs' own header lines.

follow-on: the base arm's file list omits tests/test_dispatch_names_the_health_review.py, an importer of reckon/crew/plan_review at f819399, so six of the ten extra head cases come from a file the base arm should have run and the head-minus-base delta is not over one importer set.
follow-on: the new docstring states what the function used to return, which the repo naming rules ban as changelog prose in a comment; the retirement reason reads stronger stated as mechanism.

follow-on: _land_section re-implements the section_declarations-and-status done flip that reckon/_store.py:3191 (_apply_collapse_section) already performs, and tests/test_a_section_reviewed_as_authored_stays_reviewed.py:126 duplicates the same flip.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_the_fingerprint_has_one_form.py; the manifest and the run's arm logs record that gate green (head-arm.log 442 passed EXIT=0, base-arm.log 432 passed EXIT=0) and the negative control red (negative-control-mutation.log 2 failed EXIT=1), which is the measure the section states.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to retire the pre-collapse fingerprint form and the collapse_section op so _fingerprint_forms returns the section-set and whole-document forms only; the diff narrows reckon/crew/plan_review.py:678 to a 2-tuple and drops the op from reckon/_store.py:3279, reckon/mcp.py:1269 and skills/reckon-edit/SKILL.md:399.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states status complete, lists the four commits and the gate result, and its baseline_suite and after_suite keys name the arm logs and a zero failure count, but both keys' command fields carry angle-bracket placeholders rather than the literal command.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares seven paths; the diff touches those seven plus tests/test_edit_plan_collapse_section.py, tests/test_a_section_reviewed_as_authored_stays_reviewed.py and tests/test_plan_review_store.py, and the three are covered by the coordinator's explicit scope extension in the run's resume-1-advice.txt.

justifications.durability: restoring the pre-collapse form reds tests/test_the_fingerprint_has_one_form.py:85 and :106 per negative-control-mutation.log, but the done-when's headline assertion at :97 compares the stored digest to the value the test itself handed to _store_review.
justifications.evidence: the gate is recorded green (head-arm.log 442 passed EXIT=0) but the base arm at base-arm.log ran 42 files and omitted tests/test_dispatch_names_the_health_review.py, an importer of plan_review at f819399 (:23), so the two arms are not over one importer set.
justifications.fit: the change follows the surrounding idiom, but reckon/crew/plan_review.py:687 writes changelog prose (The pre-collapse form this function used to return is retired), a phrasing that appears nowhere else in reckon/ and that the repo comment-hygiene rule bans.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:694 returns [plan_fingerprint(content), _digest(payload)] and nothing else, and the op is gone from reckon/_store.py:3279, reckon/mcp.py:1269 and skills/reckon-edit/SKILL.md:399.
justifications.reuse: the production change only removes and forks nothing, but tests/test_plan_review_store.py:449 and tests/test_a_section_reviewed_as_authored_stays_reviewed.py:126 re-implement the declaration-and-status flip that reckon/_store.py:3191 (_apply_collapse_section) already owns.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is either one of the seven declared in the manifest or one of the three the coordinator added by hand in resume-1-advice.txt.
